correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the 2×2 infected Jacobian at B0=(Λ/μ,0,0,0). Its characteristic polynomial is r²+(ω+τ+2μ)r+(ω+μ)(τ+μ)−nΛω/μ; other eigenvalues −μ. For R*<1 all eigenvalues lie in the open left half plane, and for R*>1 a real positive eigenvalue occurs. The sample (μ,ω,τ,n,Λ)=(1,2,3,1,4) gives R*=2/3 and Rsrc=4/3 exactly. For R*>1 the endemic positive equilibrium has cubic coefficients A=μ+c+a+b, B=(μ+c)(a+b), C=abc, a=ω+μ,b=τ+μ,c=nI*>0. Direct symbolic determinant reconstruction confirms these and AB>C, giving Hurwitz stability and the Caputo angle condition for every 0<α≤1. At R*=1 linearization is nonhyperbolic; no global result follows.
